entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kurdish sultan and founder of the Ayyubid dynasty (1137–1193) who united Muslim forces and recaptured Jerusalem from the Crusaders in 1187. Renowned in both Muslim and Christian sources for his chivalry and military genius.
